title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
raw_excerpt: OpenAI's GPT-6 introduces Intelligent UI to 1.2 billion ChatGPT users, enhancing responses with text, visuals, and interactive elements. It combines UI with data for dynamic, custom responses, and improves answer quality for complex queries. GPT-6 also features enhanced safety, ensuring better risk recognition and adherence to safeguards.
summary: OpenAI 正式发布 GPT-6，向 12 亿 ChatGPT 用户推出「Intelligent UI」：回答不再只是文本，而是融合文字、可视化与可交互组件，并能结合用户数据生成动态定制结果。官方称其在复杂查询上的答案质量显著提升，同时强化了风险识别与安全护栏。这是 ChatGPT 交互范式的一次重大升级，意味着大模型产品正从「对话界面」转向「生成式界面」，对下游应用生态影响深远。

title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
raw_excerpt: Claude Haiku 5.5 is optimized for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks, offering lower operating costs and faster performance for applications like summaries and customer support. The model provides significant pricing advantages, being 75% cheaper than Haiku 4.5 for tasks involving prompts up to 100,000 tokens. Enhanced safety and cybersecurity safeguards make Haiku 5.5 more secure, with broader availability across major cloud platforms like AWS and Azure.
summary: Anthropic 发布 Claude Haiku 5.5，主打高并发、成本敏感场景，如摘要生成与客服。官方称在 10 万 token 以内的提示上比 Haiku 4.5 便宜 75%，速度更快，并加强了安全与网络安全防护，已在 AWS、Azure 等主流云平台上线。对需要大规模调用小模型的开发者而言，这是性价比明显的一次迭代，也显示 Anthropic 在低价模型赛道与 OpenAI、Google 正面竞争。

title: Google is launching a one-stop Gemini agent for your work tasks
raw_excerpt: Google is launching a "universal" Gemini AI agent that can work across apps and devices in the background. The tool, announced as part of the Gemini at Work event on Thursday, will be available within the Gemini Enterprise app, allowing users to chat with the Gemini agent and assign it tasks from a single interface. In addition to having Gemini work directly inside Workspace apps like Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar, and others, users can interact with the agent from their mobile device, desktop computer, the web, and third-party apps like Slack or Microsoft 365. Since it runs in the cloud, Gemini will maintain the same context across  … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 谷歌在 Gemini at Work 2026 发布面向企业的「通用」Gemini Agent，可在后台跨应用、跨设备工作。用户可在 Gemini Enterprise 单一界面中对话并派发任务，智能体直接操作 Gmail、Drive、Docs、Sheets、Calendar，也可从手机、桌面、网页及 Slack、Microsoft 365 等第三方应用调用。值得注意的是它同时支持 Gemini 与 Claude 模型，并开放 API。这标志着企业级智能体从单点工具走向统一入口。

title: OpenAI annualised revenues $20B less than previously signalled
summary: CNBC 报道称 OpenAI 的年化收入比此前对外释放的信号低约 200 亿美元，引发 Hacker News 近 400 分、255 条评论的热议。此前 OpenAI 与 Nvidia、Oracle、CoreWeave 等签下巨额算力与芯片协议，收入预期是支撑这些交易的关键假设。若实际收入明显低于预期，可能影响其融资能力、数据中心承诺以及整个 AI 基础设施投资链条的估值逻辑，是当日最受关注的行业财务信号。

title: USA Today becomes the latest publisher to sue OpenAI
raw_excerpt: USA Today Co., along with the several local newspapers it owns, is suing OpenAI over claims that the company copied "hundreds of thousands" of articles to train its AI models, as reported earlier by Reuters . In a filing on Thursday , the publisher asks for damages of more than $250 million, alleging OpenAI's unauthorized use of its content  "has done real and continuing" harm to its outlets. This is just the latest in a string of copyright lawsuits filed against OpenAI. In addition to a copyright lawsuit filed by The New York Times , OpenAI is also facing legal action from The Intercept , CNET owner Ziff Davis , CBC/Radio-Canada , Encyclopaedia  … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 《今日美国》母公司 USA Today Co. 及其旗下多家地方报纸起诉 OpenAI，指控其未经授权复制「数十万篇」文章用于模型训练，索赔超过 2.5 亿美元。这是继《纽约时报》、The Intercept、CN 等之后又一起针对 OpenAI 的版权诉讼。新闻出版商的集体诉讼正在形成规模效应，可能推动训练数据授权市场与合理使用边界的司法界定，对整个大模型行业的合规成本有直接影响。

title: Google’s AI note-taking app transcribes your meetings completely offline
raw_excerpt: Google has released an experimental note-taking app that can transcribe meetings and audio files entirely offline, as reported earlier by TechCrunch . The app, called Google AI Edge Foresight , is free to use and runs on macOS using the company's on-device EmbeddingGemma 2 model . Similar to AI note-taking apps like Granola and Wispr Flow, Foresight summarizes your meetings while providing a space where you can take your own notes. Google says you can jot down shorthand bullet points during your meeting, and the app will transform them into "polished notes" based on the information in the transcript. Along with transcribing your meetings, For … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 谷歌发布实验性笔记应用 Google AI Edge Foresight，可在完全离线状态下转录会议与音频文件，运行于 macOS，基于端侧 EmbeddingGemma 2 模型。用户可在会议中随手记要点，应用会结合转录内容将其整理成「润色后的笔记」，功能类似 Granola、Wispr Flow。其意义在于把会议转录这一高敏感场景放到本地推理，回应了企业对数据外泄的顾虑，也是端侧小模型实用化的一个标志性案例。

title: Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception
raw_excerpt:
作者: Oskar J. Hollinsworth, Alex F. Spies, Tigist Diriba, Adam Gleave, Chris Cundy
摘要: Recent incidents have highlighted the challenge of monitoring LLM agents and the danger of models deceiving people. We show that white-box deception detection via probes can be scaled up to frontier monitoring settings by collecting the largest deception dataset to date for training probes and introducing a novel probe architecture which can aggregate information across many layers and tokens. Our probes achieve 98.8% AUC in SHADE-Arena, surpassing an Opus 5.5 text-monitoring baseline, and show improved efficacy as the underlying model is scaled up. To push our probes to their limit, we test them on several cases where deception cannot be determined from the context alone. In these cases, which we refer to as introspective deception, the ground truth can only be determined through careful elicitation or thorough knowledge of a model's training data. In one such evaluation, we show that probes can distinguish transcripts containing a model's true hidden goal from other goals with an AUC of up to 99.7%. Our probes also readily detect deception on prominent open-weight models which lie about politically sensitive topics, and about their beliefs when put under pressure. We release our training dataset, dubbed FIBS, to help drive frontier deployment of effective probes, and encourage the community to expand upon it with further examples of deception and sabotage.
summary: 论文提出用白盒探针（probe）大规模检测 LLM 智能体的欺骗与蓄意破坏行为。作者构建了迄今最大的欺骗数据集，并提出可跨多层、多 token 聚合信息的新型探针架构，在 SHADE-Arena 上达到 98.8% AUC，超过 Opus 5.5 的文本监控基线，且能捕捉模型未言明的欺骗。这为前沿模型部署中的实时监控提供了可扩展方案，是 AI 安全对齐方向少见的强实证结果。

title: On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons---a statistical look at the METR plot
raw_excerpt:
作者: Drew T. Nguyen, William Fithian
摘要: METR's 50\% time horizon measures the human completion time of software tasks that an AI solves with 50\% probability, allowing AI capabilities to be expressed in interpretable units. On 228 tasks and 26 AIs, we recompute the time horizons using splines and item-response theory to relax the assumption that the AI difficulty of a task depends linearly on the log of human time. Our fitted spline can be interpreted as a function that \emph{converts} human time to AI difficulty; it is nearly flat in a region from 2--30 min but close to linear elsewhere. Hence, a time-horizon jump from 3 min to 30 min is much easier than one from 30 min to 5 hours despite the same multiplier of $10 \times$. Overall, we contribute time-horizon point estimates that perform better under a cross-validated suite of proper scoring rules, as well as diagnostic plots for assessing time horizons' construct validity. We suggest that time horizons be interpreted together with the diagnostic plots, especially as new time-horizon-based benchmarks are proposed or existing ones grow to include longer tasks.
summary: 该论文对 METR 著名的「50% 时间跨度」曲线做统计学重估。作者在 228 个任务、26 个 AI 上，用样条与项目反应理论放松「任务 AI 难度与人类耗时对数线性相关」的假设，发现拟合出的换算函数在 2–30 分钟区间近乎平坦、其余区间接近线性。这意味着 METR 图对 AI 能力增长速度的解读可能存在系统性偏差，对「AI 何时超越人类」的预测有重要修正意义。

title: Oracle, Broadcom, and SpaceX Seek Blockbuster Debt Deals to Pay for AI Chips
raw_excerpt: Broadcom has been working to arrange more than $50 billion in financing for OpenAI's custom AI chip. Apollo and Blackstone are among the lenders Broadcom has talked to about participating in the deal. Oracle is separately in talks with Apollo and Goldman Sachs to arrange money for a big purchase of chips. SpaceX has talked to lenders in recent days about a $40 billion chip financing for Nvidia chips.
summary: 《华尔街日报》报道，Broadcom 正为 OpenAI 定制 AI 芯片安排超 500 亿美元融资，已与 Apollo、Blackstone 等接触；Oracle 另与 Apollo、高盛洽谈大额芯片采购资金；SpaceX 近几日则与贷方讨论 400 亿美元用于购买 Nvidia 芯片。三家巨头同时以债务方式为算力买单，显示 AI 基建正从股权融资转向杠杆化，一旦回报不及预期，风险将传导至信贷市场。

title: Multimodal embeddings beyond a single vector
raw_excerpt: The Perplexity team launched PPLX-EMBED-V2-LATE, providing multi-vector, multimodal embeddings that enable richer retrieval across text and images. These models retain token-level vectors and utilize a shared embedding space, leading to improved retrieval on benchmarks like ViDoRe(V3). Available in two sizes, 0.6B and 9B, they offer industry-leading performance for various retrieval tasks while maintaining efficiency.
summary: Perplexity 发布 PPLX-EMBED-V2-LATE，一种多向量、多模态嵌入模型，保留 token 级向量并共享同一嵌入空间，使文本与图像的检索更细粒度。提供 0.6B 与 9B 两个规模，在 ViDoRe(V3) 等基准上取得领先的检索表现，同时保持效率。相比传统单向量嵌入，这一路线对文档、图表混合的 RAG 场景更友好，也反映检索层正成为大模型产品差异化的关键战场。
